submission.justification:
Selection-S3 at 40% signal efficiency achieves the highest expected signal significance of 3.337σ among all viable options. This represents a substantial improvement of 0.667σ over the best achievable significance with Selection-S1 (2.67σ at 60% efficiency).

Key findings from the optimization study:
- Selection-S2 was excluded due to failing data/MC validation (>10% disagreement)
- Selection-S1 and S3 both passed validation requirements
- S1 optimization: peaked at 2.67σ (60% efficiency)
- S3 optimization: peaked at 3.337σ (40% efficiency)

The recommended configuration satisfies all constraints and provides the optimal discovery potential for this rare process search with 140 fb⁻¹ of data.

requirements.evidence: Selection-S3 passes validation (s3_passes_validation = 1), indicating all variables used by this selection show acceptable data/MC agreement.
The recommended efficiency of 40% falls within the required range of 20-80% (efficiency_in_valid_range = 1).
